result.summary: The Employees’ Retirement System of the State of Hawaii seeks proposals for non-discretionary real estate investment consulting services. Firms must be U.S.-based, registered under the Investment Advisers Act of 1940, have at least three years in business and a defined-benefit public pension client with assets over $5 billion. The assigned lead consultant must have at least seven years’ experience advising public pension plans on domestic and international real estate. The RFP is available from 9:30 a.m. HST on February 6, 2017, by calling (808) 586-1776 or through ers.ehawaii.gov/resources/procurement and www.spo.hawaii.gov. To receive addenda, prospective offerors must register at dbf.ers.procure@hawaii.gov. Submit proposals to the ERS, 201 Merchant Street, Suite 1400, Honolulu, HI 96813-2980, by 4:30 p.m. HST on March 20, 2017; late proposals will not be considered.
